[[File:Alternate World Chloe.png|thumb|250px|Alternate World Chloe (right)]] '''Alternate World Chloe''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|平行世界|へいこうせかい}}のコハル''' ''Alternate World Koharu'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN090|Showdown at the Gates of Warp!]]''. She is [[Chloe]]'s counterpart from the {{pkmn|multiverse#In animation|Alternate World}}. Alternate Chloe first appeared in [[Canalave City]], from where she and [[Alternate World Goh]] picked up [[Alternate World Ash]] and [[Alternate World Dawn|Dawn]] up before heading to the [[Spear Pillar]], having been called to do so by regular [[Goh]]. When Dawn and Ash noticed that Alternate Goh's Pokémon weren't being [[Devolution|rewound]], Alternate World Chloe explained that she had hacked into [[Alternate World Team Rocket]]'s database and constructed copies of the suits they were using to protect them and their Pokémon from the time reversal. Alternate Chloe later participated in the battle against Alternate World Team Rocket, until a power burst from {{OBP|Dialga|recurring}} destroyed her protective suit and caused her, along with every other person present, to turn younger and sent Team Rocket blasting off. {{Ash}}, Goh, {{an|Dawn}}, Chloe, and their alternate counterparts prayed for {{p|Arceus}} to stop Dialga and {{OBP|Palkia|recurring}}'s fight, which it did, allowing the two [[Legendary Pokémon]] to undo the time reversal and return all the devolved Pokémon back to normal. Alternate World Chloe and regular Chloe bid farewell as the latter was returned to her own world. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Alternate World Chloe |pkmn=Eevee |type1=Normal |gender=female |img=Dawn Goh Piplup Scorbunny Eggs.png |cap=Alternate World Chloe's Eevee an Egg |img2=Alternate World Chloe Eevee.png |epnum=JN090 |epname=Showdown at the Gates of Warp! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Eevee}} is Alternate World Chloe's only known Pokémon. She participated in the battle against [[Alternate World Team Rocket]], but she was reverted into an {{pkmn|Egg}} when {{OBP|Dialga|recurring}}'s powers went out of control. After {{p|Arceus}} stopped the fight between Dialga and {{OBP|Palkia|recurring}}, the {{pkmn|category|Temporal and Spatial Pokémon}} repaired the distortions their fighting had caused and restored all the [[Devolution|devolved]] Pokémon back to normal. Eevee's only known move is {{m|Copycat}}.
Eevee has also used {{m|Bubble Beam}}{{tt|*|Dawn's Piplup's}} via Copycat.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{white color}}|bordercolor={{blue color dark}}|textcolor=fff |ja=花澤香菜 ''[[Kana Hanazawa]]'' |en=[[Cherami Leigh]] |ar=غدير بزي ''Ghadir Bazzi'' |ca=Estel Tort |fr_eu=Lise Leclercq |pt_br=Gabriela Medeiros |es_la=Lupita Leal }} ==Trivia== * In the original Japanese version, Alternate World Chloe's speech patterns are more confident and smarter in comparison to her counterpart, similar to [[Alternate World Goh]]. {{-}} {{Project COD notice}} [[Category:Female characters]] [[Category:Animation characters]] [[Category:Journeys characters of the day]] [[es:Chloe del otro mundo]] [[it:Cloe Mondo Parallelo]]
